nom: d'Alba Piedmont White Truffle Vital Calming Spray Serum

segments.oily: A few reviewers with oily skin found the serum too rich, describing a greasy or shiny finish, and one recommends pairing it with setting powder to control the sheen.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the mist as genuinely hydrating, though a couple with very dry skin still layer a heavier moisturizer on top.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including some with an oily T-zone and dry cheeks, report it works well as a refreshing, non-greasy layer.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describe the formula as gentle and calming on sensitive or irritated skin, though the fragrance is flagged as a possible issue for those sensitive to scent.
segments.mature: A reviewer with dry, mature skin reports softened skin without a major visual change yet, while several reviewers in their 40s describe a refreshed, less dull look.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the mist leaves skin hydrated, dewy, and soft; one reviewer felt slightly drier after it settled and didn't get the hydration boost she expected.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report the spray calms redness and irritation quickly, including after a chemical peel, hormonal breakouts, or retinol use.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers, including some with combination skin, say it doesn't add oiliness, but a few with oily skin found it left a greasy or shiny finish that needed setting powder.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer sensitive to oil had a slight breakout until changing the order of application, while most other reviewers report no breakouts from the spray.

aspects.libelle: Fragrance may be too strong for scent-sensitive users
Layers well under and over makeup
Some find it comparable to cheaper alternatives

extraits.texte: I didn't love this product. This is my second time trying something from d'alba and it just does not seem to agree with my skin. I have somewhat oily skin, but not super oily. However, the two things I've tried from them have made my skin so oily and greasy. I think this would work a lot better for dry skin!

I have used this product for a week. I have not noticed much difference yet. I am still unsure if this is a setting spray or an anti aging spray. I do not care for the smell. Also no matter how much I spray the oil sits at the top of the bottle within seconds of shaking it.

extraits.titre: Good hydration in an easy spray
extraits.texte: I've been using this spray for about three weeks and I really like it. It makes my dry, mature skin feel so soft, and the scent is really pleasant. I haven't seen major visual changes yet, but the softening and hydrating feel are definitely there and I've used a lot of expensive hydrating products. You do have to hold your breath when you spray it because the mist is easy to inhale. Other than that, it's a great boost my skin really enjoys. Make sure you shake it well before using. I also love that it's a spray because it hits every spot on my face so easily. It's earned a spot in my routine because my skin genuinely enjoys the boost.

I suffer with hormonal breakouts that also cause my skin to become red, irritated and dry and I learned from a masterclass that white truffles in skincare can help not only with inflammation but also a plethora of other skin issues as well as sagging anti-aging and provides a lot of hydration to the skin thanks to white truffles being an enzyme that is packed with vitamin C and is an essential fatty acid. I found out that d'Alba uses white truffles exclusively in their products and I am so happy that I got to try this spray serum from them because it has worked wonders for my dry irritated skin, I just spray 2 or 3 pumps of the fine spray and it calms my skins instantly and with continuous use my skin feels and looks hydrated, calmed and just healthier looking overall. I am so happy that I have this in my life now and I can't wait to try their other amazing skincare products because I know they will be beneficial for me.

I've had a chance to use this both day and night for a few weeks now and it's safe to say I have a new favorite part of my skincare routine. It's so easy to spray it on after toner. It's lightweight but hydrating at the same time. There is a light fragrance so I would not recommend to people who are sensitive to fragrances. If you've very dry skin you may need to still use a more hydrating moisturizer but I pair it with a lightweight moisturizer without issues.

I received d'Alba White Truffle Vital Spray Serum to try and I love it! It delivers instant hydration and a fresh, clean, dewy glow without feeling heavy. I have combo skin so the T zone area gets oily with dry patches around the cheeks. The serum has very fine texture, quickly absorbs into skin without leaving sticky residue. It can be used as a toner, serum, setting spray or throughout the day refresher, so it's really handy to keep one on the road.
